messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Acme Health wants to spin up a demo sandbox with masked prod data for their exec demo next week. Legal flagged SOC2 evidence requirement before we allow any copies. Any quick wins?

oleg_security: Do we have a standard masking + ephemeral env policy we can point to? Need to avoid ad-hoc exceptions.

ben_engineering: We can provision a read-only snapshot + run a scrubbing job that replaces PII with deterministic tokens. Need confirmation on KMS key usage and that non-prod networks are isolated.

jess_legal: We'll need a short control mapping to SOC2 controls (CC6/CC7) showing how data is pseudonymized, how access is limited, and retention/destruction steps. Also DPA amendment signed for the copy.

sara_acme: We can accept tight constraints. Exec demo is Thurs — can you share scrub process and a sample report?

maria_cs: Proposed approach: 1) create ephemeral sandbox bucket 2) run scrub job w/ masking profile 3) provide scrub report + audit log 4) delete after 30 days. Oleg — can you draft the SOC2 control mapping and an audit checklist?

oleg_security: Draft checklist (first pass):
```
- Source snapshot access limited to service account svc-demo-acme
- Scrub job run with masking profile 'acme-demo'
- KMS key alias/redwood-demo enforces encryption at rest
- Logs of scrub job (stdout + hash of scrubbed fields) stored in secure logging bucket
- Sandbox network restricted to demo CIDR and no egress to prod VPCs
- Automatic deletion job scheduled: delete after 30d
- Manual sign-off: Security + Legal before data handed to customer
```
I'll expand sections and map to SOC2 controls.

ben_engineering: For infra, I need a temporary IAM role + a short TTL service account. I'll open an infra PR and link it here: PR #3721 — includes IAM policy and scheduler for deletion.

deploy-bot: deploybot: scrub-job v1.2 deployed to staging — build 2026.03.20-3721 :white_check_mark:

jess_legal: Approve in principle contingent on: (a) SOC2 mapping doc, (b) signed DPA amendment, (c) scrub run report with hashes. Send evidence link here and I'll sign off.

maria_cs: Copy. I'll coordinate with Acme: asking for DPA signature + confirm they can wait for scrub report before the demo handoff. @sara_acme — can your team sign the amendment by Tue? :thumbsup:

sara_acme: Yes, we'll prioritize. Can you get the scrub report by Tue morning? Execs need time to rehearse.

maria_cs: I'll aim for Tue AM. Ben/Oleg — please prioritize PR + control mapping. I'll update Acme and set expectations.

oleg_security: Will post SOC2 mapping link here once ready.

ben_engineering: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3721 — includes cron for deletion and KMS usage notes. ETA: Mon EOD for staging scrub run.

maria_cs: Great, thanks team. I'll follow up with Acme and move this to onboarding backlog.

sara_acme: Thanks all — excited to show the demo.

maria_cs: Closing loop: will post evidence bundle (scrub report + logs + mapping) to the shared drive and tag @jess_legal when done.
